message: Additional cross-lease need: WorkingTurnGuidance.AgentCache currently exposes only Get, so Client.fs cannot distinguish a fresh cached Working/Free/absent state from a miss. A small TryGetFresh(now, projectId, agentId) API lets dispatch skip the legacy host-fence Git reads only when cached state proves there is no activation side effect; Ready still gets a fresh fence check and snapshot, and cache misses retain the current fail-closed ordering. Please coordinate a narrow lease for WorkingTurnGuidance.fs + its focused tests too, if unowned. This avoids moving fence checks under the cache lock or adding a snapshot fetch before a denied Ready activation.
